title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – request for a revised package
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quote. We would value working with you on the HX series, but your EUR 36.00 is well above the market. A current rival offer stands at EUR 31.50 per unit with 42 days lead time (offer:70240-1-a). Energy producer prices fell from 137.0 to 131.9, a change of -3.72% (idx:PPI-D351@2026-08). Your team told us that your second shift has been on hold since spring (doc:20260722-70210-M2), so 8,400 pieces over 24 months would fill idle capacity.

Could you share a cost breakdown (material, machining, overhead) and review your price against current material and energy costs? The attached complete packages reflect where we need to be.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: Pump shaft HX (part:320070) – request for a revised package
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I checked the rival offer. I can beat it and do €31.00, and we even keep the faster 28 days lead time. As to the rival quote data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. We have to stick to 30 days payment though, cash is tight. 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We can do the 42 days lead time you asked for, but 90 days payment is just too long for us to give a discount. We really hope to build a great partnership with you!

Our offer is a price of €32.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net, we can offer a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days. We are super eager to work together!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
